preconditions.description: The length of str1 must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The length of str2 must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str1)
preconditions.description: All characters in str1 must be lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str2)
preconditions.description: All characters in str2 must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in return_value for c in str1)
postconditions.description: str1 must be a subsequence of the return value.

postconditions.expression: all(c in return_value for c in str2)
postconditions.description: str2 must be a subsequence of the return value.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: All characters in the return value must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(str1) + len(str2) - len([c for i, c in enumerate(str1) if c == str2[i]])
postconditions.description: The return value must be the shortest string that has both str1 and str2 as subsequences.
